full_judgment: 2. The case of the petitioner is that one Kailash Chandra De had three sons namely Ramkamal, Nilkamal and Jagneswar. The said Ramkamal died leaving only one son namely Chitta Ranjan and Nilkamal died leaving two sons namely Anil and Niranjin and a daughter. Before partition of the country Jagneswar & Chitta Ranjan used to live in India. After partition Anil and Niranjan Left Pakistan for India in 1950. At that time they requested the petitioner who is the son-in-law of Nilkamal and brother-in-law of Anil and Niranjan to come to their house and to look after their properties on after behalf, and on their request the petitioner came to his father-in-law's house and was residing there since 1952 and looking after the properties. Jnanada Sundari, the mother of Chitta Ranjan did not leave the country with him and was in Pakistan who also used to look after the properties along With the petitioner jointly. The petitioner and his wife who is the daughter of Nil Kamal gild sister of Anil and Niranjan were enjoying the said properties as their own.
